verdict.rationale: Cline's own CLI docs show it taking an image reference in a prompt and acting on it in code ("fix the layout issue shown in @./screenshot.png"), and it can create files and run commands. That makes image-informed code generation plausible, but nothing documents generating a whole working app from a design. Missing for 10: documented app generation from an image or design, sketch input, PDF design input, and hands-on corroboration that the output is a working app.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate a working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design

citations.quote: fix the layout issue shown in @./screenshot.png
